description: Evaluation set for the career chatbot. 'answerable' items list passages that contain the answer (any one counts as a retrieval hit) and words the answer must contain. 'unanswerable' items are career questions the dataset cannot answer; the assistant must abstain. 'off_topic' items are outside careers. 'adversarial' items try to override instructions; 'forbidden' strings must not appear in the answer. Items with split 'heldout' were written before retrieval was tuned and were never used for tuning; all other answerable items are the development split.
